title: Nice Fluffy Malaysian Noodle Dish
description: A sweet and fluffy Malaysian noodle dish featuring apricot jam, this ovo-vegetarian-friendly recipe is perfect for a quick and energizing meal. The al-dente finish of the noodles provides a satisfying texture to the dish.
instructions: Cook the rice noodles according to the package instructions until they are al-dente, then set aside.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or frying pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for another minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the bean sprouts and cook until they are tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan, then add a little more oil if necessary and scramble in the eggs until they are cooked through.
Mix the eggs with the vegetables, then add the cooked noodles, apricot jam, and soy sauce to the pan.
Stir everything together to combine, ensuring the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Serve the noodle dish hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
